action: Obtain, curate, update taxonomy, and incorporate Dolichoderinae phylogeny into donor-tree resources and downstream analyses.
outcome: Located, curated, and taxonomically updated Dolichoderinae phylogeny. Added donor tree to source-tree set and reran workflow after validating resulting placements.

summary: Correct generic-tree placements based on updated evidence regarding placement of Paranilidris and Ecphorella.
action: Rebuild generic tree, place Paranilidris appropriately, move Ecphorella to the Tapinoma genus group, regraft affected taxa, and rerun workflow.
outcome: Generic backbone was rebuilt. Paranilidris was added and Ecphorella was reassigned to the Tapinoma genus group following Lieberman et al. (2026). Ecphorella was regrafted and downstream analyses were rerun.

summary: Remove obsolete or invalid donor-tree terminals that conflict with current taxonomy.
action: Review source trees and remove or rename outdated terminals causing taxonomic inconsistencies.
outcome: Removed or renamed Leptomyrmex_relictus from donor trees and removed Chronoxenus and Arnoldius from the Zalla donor tree. Workflow was rerun and validated after these corrections.

summary: Evaluate incorporation of the DeMarco Aphaenogaster phylogeny into the ant macrophylogeny.
action: Assess the phylogeny for novel taxonomic coverage, reproducibility, and compatibility with existing donor-tree resources.
outcome: The phylogeny was evaluated but not incorporated because it did not provide sufficient added value relative to existing Aphaenogaster coverage in the workflow. Resources were prioritized toward other updates with greater taxonomic impact.

summary: Evaluate a second recently published Leptanillinae phylogeny for possible incorporation.
action: Determine whether the phylogeny contributes novel taxa or placements not already represented in incorporated Leptanillinae trees.
outcome: The phylogeny was not incorporated. Leptanilla anomala was the only newly placeable taxon and its placement relied on morphological evidence. Incorporation would require substantial additional curation and donor-tree processing for minimal gain in taxonomic coverage.

summary: Rerun TACT grafting without geography-informed constraints and compare the resulting macrophylogeny with previous outputs.
action: Remove the geography-informed option from TACT grafting, regenerate the tree, and validate resulting placements and workflow outputs.
outcome: TACT grafting was rerun without geography-informed constraints. The revised workflow completed successfully and generated the updated macrophylogeny used for subsequent testing and release preparation.
